note: Every research thread this project has concluded, with its verdict and where the evidence lives. Verdicts: DEAD = tested and killed, do not re-test without a NEW mechanism; DISCOUNT = real but weaker/conditional than headline; TRUST = replicated on held-out data; OPEN = live lead being tracked; TOOL = built infrastructure, not an edge claim; RETIRED = user decision, not a statistical kill.

entries.name: Bayer five-fold astrology (1937 method)
entries.finding: Progressed-Moon 15° grid on 435 NSE names / 75.5k flips: timing, direction, and a 12-config sweep ALL chance; placebo group identical. Engine verified vs Solar Fire ±1.4".

entries.name: Factor zoo — 462 factors
entries.finding: 462 factors collapse to ~2 independent bets (SIZE + MOMENTUM≡RS corr +0.98); the 12m-RS upgrade died inside the real GATI book — decile results don't transfer to a filtered book.

entries.name: Intraday 15-min cross-sectional reversal
entries.finding: 1.85 bps gross per leg vs the ~7 bps cost floor — independently replicates the xsec wall.

entries.name: Intraday cross-sectional hunt (6 families)
entries.finding: 0/6 families survive: real gross +2..+6 bps/leg everywhere, all under the ~6 bps zero-slip cost floor. X4 lead-lag was the cleanest signal (futures data could revive it).

entries.name: Participant footprint screens (FII/retail/prop)
entries.finding: Fade-retail, follow-FII, lottery-peak primaries all dead on participant_oi 2022-26.

entries.name: DII futures 5-day net → next-day
entries.finding: IC +0.10 on both splits but 2026 flat — DISCOUNT lead, forward-track only.

entries.name: CPR-agent ML (classifier + RL vs placebo twins)
entries.finding: CPR's 7th death. Models match placebo-level twins; RL with ₹-reward learned all-skip (discovered cash). A yday_ret lookahead survived every kill-test EXCEPT permutation importance — a profitable placebo IS the alarm.

entries.name: M0UIZ 1H CPR-BC reclaim entry
entries.finding: His +68.3%/10-day book decomposed: entry dead 4 ways (114k events, all cells premium-negative). The engine was 68% base-rate × 10.7x payoff × hold-through; UNOMINDA rule-break = 44% of net.

entries.name: Dad's discretionary VCP playbook
entries.finding: Every lever sign-flips FNO→wide universe = survivorship, not edge. Lesson: report the wide universe first.

entries.name: Earnings reaction — direction
entries.finding: The WINDOW is real (3.9x more travel after minute 1, ~1.5% to close) but nothing calls direction: blind test n=25, model 52% vs always-DOWN 56%; biggest beat FELL.

entries.name: Announcement materiality (size ÷ turnover)
entries.finding: Spread sign-flips train→test (−10.2% @20d held out). The ratio was a size-factor proxy measuring smallcap-vs-largecap rotation.

entries.name: GIFT Nifty overnight drift / open-reversion
entries.finding: H2 drift dead; H3 open-reversion real on the un-gettable auction print, −0.4 bps at a real NIFTY_FUT fill; H5 flat.

entries.name: GIFT evening volatility → next-day risk dial
entries.finding: Real next-day risk signal, incremental over lagged vol, holds on both halves — awaiting a book to gate.

entries.name: Failed-break fade (15-min CPR)
entries.finding: 75k events: the long-side profit was pure drift; level-breaks dead BOTH directions.

entries.name: Gann Square of 9
entries.finding: ~29M events vs 3 null models: Gann never beats equidistant/random-phase nulls; the √-geometry adds nothing.

entries.name: RVOL — all 5 roles
entries.finding: Trigger, fade, gate, exit, sizing all closed (fade real but illiquid + decayed). Root: it can't pick the trade — the losing bar arrives unannounced.

entries.name: Real-volume VWAP fade + fakeout+OI (index futures)
entries.finding: Both dead on the real futures volume/OI store (spot index volume is 0 forever — futures is the only real index orderflow source).

entries.name: VWAP band fade
entries.finding: v1 AND faithful v2: 0/436 combos held out; the '90% WR' was false; re-test on real futures volume also dead.

entries.name: Volume-conditioned momentum (Lee-Swaminathan)
entries.finding: RARE survivor: spread real at +35/+57 bps/mo held-out, cost-robust. Absolute CAGR is survivorship fiction; transplant into the Minervini book DEAD.

entries.name: Sector #2-vs-#1 RS rotation
entries.finding: 2nd-best RS name vs the leader = coin flip.

entries.name: VCP / coil as mechanical entry
entries.finding: Dead 6 ways — coil subtracts value as a mechanical entry or long-vol proxy. Only compression↔expansion MAGNITUDE survived (not direction).

entries.name: GATI exit reworks
entries.finding: Exits are a solved, dead lever for the RS book — every rework tested worse.

entries.name: ZN5894 fade tradebook
entries.finding: The stated mechanical rule is DEAD, but discretionary selection is REAL (p≈0.000). The leak was holding past entry day → journal + risk rules.

entries.name: Episodic Pivot (Qullamaggie)
entries.finding: Kickoff → pullback → breakout: all 8 cells dead.

entries.name: CPR-Swing Angle 0
entries.finding: The apparent edge was plain 21-EMA trend; the CPR component flips sign train→test.

entries.name: cpr_swing mechanical setups (all)
entries.finding: Every mechanical setup dead or beta; the best book loses to a 200-SMA filter. The untested residue = discretion → journal.

entries.name: Markov regime states
entries.finding: States are real; every tradeable use tested is dead. Open lead: weekly-context.

entries.name: GEX (gamma exposure)
entries.finding: 21+ hypotheses dead. Fully closed.

entries.name: Trade book skill-vs-beta (2,258 trades)
entries.finding: Selection skill dead (clustered p=0.45); the profit was BHARATFORG concentration in a bull tape.

entries.name: Minervini regime overlay (DD-cut)
entries.finding: The drawdown-cut replicates; built into minervini_signals.py. A risk dial, not a return booster.

entries.name: RS long-short monthly
entries.finding: Long-only leg: CAGR 50.1% / Sharpe 1.28 after the lookahead patch. Short leg dead. Became the GATI book's ancestor.

entries.name: Pullback-to-EMA swing
entries.finding: Works but weaker than headline; gap-fill variant DEAD.

entries.name: RS dynamic-cross
entries.finding: All timeframes dead. Do not re-test.

entries.name: CPR HTF quick-scalp
entries.finding: 0/16 configs net-positive held out.

entries.name: VIX regime gate
entries.finding: Worse than the simple Nifty-SMA gate on the same book.

entries.name: Pullback-rotation (winner-pausing)
entries.finding: Can't distinguish winner-pausing from loser-topping.

entries.name: PCR < 1 + PE-side filter
entries.finding: Validated OOS as CONTEXT (fade backdrop), not direction; max-pain dead; as a scalp filter it HURTS.

entries.name: Kronos ML break-vs-fake
entries.finding: Can't predict break-vs-fake; its confidence gate was a volatility proxy.

entries.name: Index dispersion signal
entries.finding: No replicating signal; BankNifty monthly-only kills the vehicle anyway.

entries.name: Alpha hunt: flow / skew / rotation / parity-basis
entries.finding: All four sign-flip train→test.

entries.name: Short ATM straddle (theta harvest)
entries.finding: The ONE held-out-positive lead from the barrier scan: delta-neutral short premium. Needs cost + tail validation before any capital.

entries.name: Gujral ORB + candlestick confluence
entries.finding: Index/equity ORB + candlestick confluence dead across the chapter. Don't re-test.

entries.name: Index microstructure 1-min lead
entries.finding: The 1-min lead was an index-staleness artifact; the ~11pt fade bounce was the only real structure.

entries.name: Cam/CPR breakout book (entry-fill teardown)
entries.finding: Entry booked at the level but confirmed at the close ~1.95% past it — the whole modeled edge lives in that un-gettable gap. No entry (lagging, leading, filtered, LTF-confirm) recovers it.

entries.name: Intraday option BUYING (all mechanisms)
entries.finding: Momentum continuation, reversal, compression-straddle: all dead to THETA. Buying short-dated premium intraday is negative-carry, always. Only SELL-theta or swing-underlying can survive.

entries.name: 1-min option-buying backtest (Mar–Jun)
entries.finding: Honest re-run: −69.5%; the apparent wins were bugs.

entries.name: Minervini momentum — intraday vs positional
entries.finding: The momentum edge lives overnight/positional; intraday expression dead. Foundation of the GATI book.

entries.name: Nifty scalp (mechanical index scalp program)
entries.finding: User decision: no edge worth the execution risk. Honest numbers were execution-gated (first-candle fills); daemon + tape KEPT for research.

entries.name: Range-scale position sizing
entries.finding: Loses to the live pb=18/28 config OOS; its apparent wins were mislabels.

entries.name: Scalp big-loss filters
entries.finding: No filter cuts the big losses — they're irreducible; manage via SIZING.

entries.name: Expiry cutoff + premium-stop
entries.finding: Both worse than baseline; the blowup was variance, not a fixable rule.

entries.name: MFT relationship screens (7 cheap screens)
entries.finding: 7/7 dead; only futures-basis remains scoped (not built).

entries.name: Sector rotation (wider idea batch)
entries.finding: Sector rotation discount; TS trend + 52wk-breadth DEAD; FII/DII history too short.

entries.name: CPR option momentum (rupee-honest)
entries.finding: Rupee edge ≈ ₹0 — always judge option strategies in RUPEES, not percent.

entries.name: Day-character ER gauge
entries.finding: Descriptive intraday expansion/contraction gauge with validated persistence — context lens on the Today tab, not an entry signal.

entries.name: Orderflow footprint lens (absorption/initiative)
entries.finding: 3s-tape episode detector at levels for USER discretion; replay-and-correct pending. Pine can't ingest external data → TV overlay via MCP.

entries.name: Contraction Score (chartist VCP shrinking-box)
entries.finding: Reproduces the YouTube macro-funnel + micro-tightness scores with a subjectivity meter. Shape-not-direction guardrail; Nifty500 only.

entries.name: GATI (RS/Minervini positional book)
entries.finding: The compounding book. Headline '48% CAGR' splits into 85% (2021-23) vs 13.7% (2024-26) — quote regime numbers. N=5 concentration, leverage, faster-rebalance all tested and REJECTED. ₹5L forward paper test running.

entries.name: News → hypothesis → stock engine
entries.finding: v1 built + dry-run validated (whole-market resolver, Haiku gate + Opus map, immutable journal). Blocked on an Anthropic API key in .env.

entries.name: Upstox news + fundamentals APIs
entries.finding: Both DO exist (/v2/news, /v2/fundamentals/{isin}/income-statement) — structured quarterly rev/PAT replaces PDF parsing. Gotchas documented.
